strongest_attack: Strongest attack: that Section 4's dual-number Serre-pairing test only controls first-order vanishing and cannot upgrade J subset I_e to scheme-theoretic equality Fit_0(coker Phi)=I_e on nonreduced bases without an explicit regular-embedding/conormal-rank citation. Outcome: attack fails. For every nonzero relative tangent xi the pullback computation gives i_xi^*J=(eps), so the image of J spans the full conormal fibre; I=J+I^2 and the second Nakayama step on the finite module I/J then force I=J stalkwise with pure Nakayama, without needing a separate regular-sequence presentation of I_e. Secondary ambient attack: R^1s_*End(F)=0 is only sufficient for surjectivity of r (the connecting map in (8.4) could vanish even if R^1 is nonzero). Outcome: does not break the theorem, which assumes the vanishing as a hypothesis and verifies it on the balanced locus. Tertiary: balanced specialization still carries the equation-bundle freeness/BC hypothesis on q_*script-W; the writeup correctly retains that hypothesis rather than claiming it follows from fibrewise O(4)+O(5).
theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero, B a locally Noetherian k-scheme, pi:C->B a smooth proper morphism with geometrically connected genus-g fibres, and x_1,...,x_n:B->C pairwise disjoint sections with n>=1 and Gamma=sum x_i(B). Let 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 be exact on C, with W_4,W_5 invertible, W locally free of rank two, and constant fibre degrees d_4,d_5 satisfying d_4-n>2g-2 and d_5-n=2g-2. Put phi:pi_*W->pi_*(W|Gamma), N=omega_{C/B} tensor W_5^vee(Gamma), P=Pic^0_{C/B}, a_N:B->P, and let e:B->P be the identity. Then Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e; hence the intrinsic evaluation-failure scheme is exactly a_N^{-1}(e(B)), formation commutes with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change, the scheme represents relative triviality of N, and the identity descends along smooth atlases to locally Noetherian algebraic stacks. For the ambient comparison, additionally let s:P1_B->B, let p:X=P_{P1_B}(E^vee)->P1_B be a P2-bundle, let gamma:C->P1_B be a finite flat degree-four cover with CE embedding i:C->X, and assume its ideal has the standard degree-four CE resolution 0->O_X(-4) tensor p^*det(F)->O_X(-2) tensor p^*F->I_C->0 for a rank-two relations bundle F. Put q=s composed with p, script-W=O_X(2) tensor p^*F^vee, W=i^*script-W, and assume q_*script-W is finite locally free and commutes with arbitrary base change. If R^1s_*End(F)=0, then the restriction r:q_*script-W->pi_*W is surjective; consequently coker(phi composed with r)=coker(phi) canonically and compatibly with arbitrary base change, and the ambient and intrinsic zeroth Fitting ideals both equal a_N^*I_e. In particular, when (g,n)=(6,6) and every geometric fibre of F is O(4) direct-sum O(5), the canonical filtration induced by the O(5)-subbundle gives d_4=20,d_5=16, the intrinsic map has ranks 26->12, R^1s_*End(F)=0 automatically, and the actual ambient balanced CE evaluation-failure scheme is scheme-theoretically the locus where O_C(Gamma) is relatively isomorphic to W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1}.
